answer: Let G=(V,E) denote the trust graph with spectral gap λ2 governing partition barrier strength. Personalized EigenTrust vectors t_i converge as t_i←αPt_i+(1-α)r_i where P encodes normalized edge weights and r_i local reputation. Adversary meadows form disconnected plumes when λ2≫0 ensuring exponential decay of trust across cuts. Cluster isolation bounds prove ||t_h - t_a||≤e^{-γdiameter} for honest h and adversary a. Convergence follows from Perron-Frobenius: honest nodes achieve consensus t*∈span(π) where π dominant eigenvector. The sonnet captures this spectral harmony.
